title: Clone Graph
description: Given a reference to a connected undirected graph node, return a deep copy (clone) of the graph. Output the adjacency list of the cloned graph.
input_format: First line contains `n` (number of nodes). Following `n` lines contain adjacency list for node `i` (1-indexed).
hints: Use a hash map to map original nodes to their cloned counterparts.
Use BFS or DFS traversal to visit every reachable node.
Clone each neighbor and attach it to the cloned node's adjacency list.
